svg.title: The moves of the program, unrolled
svg.desc: Feed moves: a straight pass along the bar at one A angle, a turn of A across the free end face past the end of the model, and a pass back at another angle. At the chuck-side end the passes stop at the end of the model and rapids turn A. One family of passes is about A0 and one is about A180.
svg.text: Each move, unrolled: X along the bar against the A angle
